opportunities.title: Propose vulnerability identity key and lifecycle schema
opportunities.summary: ### Summary Inspect the committed Anchore JSON fixtures and propose a schema for tracking vulnerabilities over time. Specifically: what combination of fields uniquely identifies "the same vulnerability" across scans? Candidates to evaluate include CVE ID alone, CVE + package name, CVE + package name + version, and CVE + package + image. Write up the tradeoffs, pick a recommendation, and sketch the analytics DB table(s) needed to support first_seen / last_seen / fixed_at / ignored_at / cleared_at fields. **Tech notes:** The Anchore JSON schema is documented at the Anchore project site; worth skimming before diving into fixtures. The goal of this spike is a decision, not code — resist the urge to start implementing. ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Written proposal (markdown doc in PR) covering identity key options, tradeoffs, and a recommendation - [ ] Proposed analytics DB schema with column types and rationale - [ ] At least one worked example from the fixtures showing how the identity key behaves across days - [ ] Reviewed and approved by Brandon and/or Matt before next ticket starts ## Bounty: $250 This issue has been selected for our paid contributor program. opportunities.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 187200`. ### Notes The `d` character is already accepted by the token regex, so malformed-input detection still passes — the value is just never added. A fix should add the `d` unit and cover it with tests. /bounty $50
